# X.509 ECDSA test fixtures, frozen. Generated once with OpenSSL 3.6.3
# and checked in, like tests/golden/x509_fixtures.txt:
# the suite needs no openssl and no network, and the bytes under test
# never change under it. Twenty-year validity; every test that judges
# validity names its instant.
#
# Three chains:
#   ecroot -> ecinter -> ecleaf          all ECDSA: P-384 root and
#       intermediate signing with SHA-384, P-256 leaf signed with
#       SHA-256 -- the curve/hash mix the real web serves.
#   mixroot -> mixinter -> mixleaf       mixed: an RSA root signing an
#       EC intermediate, which signs an RSA leaf -- both crossings.
#   ecroot -> inter521 -> leaf521        the refusal: a P-521
#       intermediate parses (the curve OID is kept) but can verify
#       nothing, so the chain fails closed with UNSUPPORTED_ALGORITHM.
ecroot 
ecinter 
ecleaf 
mixroot 
mixinter 
mixleaf 
inter521 
leaf521
